description.value: Browns Socialhouse is a Canadian casual-dining franchise with over 80 locations, positioning itself between neighbourhood pub and upscale casual dining. The Vernon location sits in the Village Green retail area, serving fresh, flavourful American-style food in a relaxed social atmosphere. Delivery and pickup are available, making it a viable stop for cyclists who want a sit-down meal or a quick order to go.
